$comment: Online sources shipped with GoTek Manager. Edit this file rather than the code.
It is bundled at build time, and overridden at run time by a providers.json placed
in the application's configuration folder, whose path is shown in Settings. An
override replaces this list entirely; entries that fail validation are dropped and
reported rather than silently ignored.
The demozoo adapter puts the Demozoo platform number in `query` rather than a URL.
Fields: id (unique), name, adapter (internetArchive | htmlSite | jsonFeed | demozoo),
platformId (omit for every platform), query (search adapters), catalogUrl (site and
feed adapters), note (shown in the interface), ignoreRobots, userAgent.
Every htmlSite entry below was crawled the way the application crawls it, and kept
only if that crawl came back with files. Twenty sites that looked right were dropped
for coming back with nothing: a link crawler reads a file index, and cannot read a
database whose downloads sit behind a script, a session, or a page built by
JavaScript. CPC-POWER, CSDb, ZXArt, World of Spectrum, Atarimania, AtariAge, itch.io
and the forums are all of that second kind. Their software is real; it is simply not
reachable by following links, and listing them here only promised something the
application could not deliver.
Two entries are kept whose robots.txt refuses automated reading. They find nothing
until the override is turned on in that source's settings, which is a decision for
the person at the keyboard: nothing ships with it set.
A GoTek presents floppy images. New software for the 8-bit Commodores is almost
always .d64, which is a 1541 GCR recording a GoTek cannot reproduce, so those
sources will mostly show titles that cannot be used until someone converts them.
